name: Gearment Import Flatsome
author: Gearment LLC

sections.description:
Gearment Import is a comprehensive WooCommerce solution designed to streamline your product management workflow. With robust import/export capabilities and advanced variation handling, this plugin is perfect for stores with extensive product catalogs.

Key Features:

  • Bulk Product Import

    • Import products from CSV files with support for all WooCommerce product types
    • Map CSV columns to WooCommerce fields with ease
    • Handle large product catalogs with optimized performance

  • Advanced Variation Management

    • Create and manage product variations in bulk
    • Support for color, size, and model attributes
    • Beautiful swatches for product variations

  • Customizable Thank You Page

    • Design personalized order confirmation pages
    • Add custom messages and branding
    • Display order details and tracking information

  • Product Management

    • Bulk edit product information
    • Delete products in bulk
    • Update inventory and pricing efficiently

Requirements:

  • WordPress 6.1 or higher
  • WooCommerce 5.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher

Recommended:

  • WooCommerce 8.0+ for best performance
  • PHP 8.0+ for improved speed and security
  • 256MB+ PHP memory limit for large imports
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/plugin-name directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Go to Settings > Gearment Import to configure
sections.faq:
What file formats are supported for import?

The plugin supports CSV files with UTF-8 encoding.

Is there a limit to the number of products I can import?

While there’s no hard limit, we recommend importing up to 1,000 products at a time for optimal performance.

Can I schedule automatic imports?

Yes, you can set up scheduled imports using WordPress cron jobs or a third-party scheduling tool.
